simple.meaning: מָאַס (mâʼaç) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to spurn ; also (intransitively) to disappear.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 76 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, and 9 more, beginning at Leviticus 26:15. Its contexts include death, covenant, commandment, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָאַס (H3988).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָאַס (mâʼaç) / H3988 is traced through Leviticus 26:15, Leviticus 26:43, Leviticus 26:44, Numbers 11:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.
